name: 2-2-r14-exit-transition

movement.instructions: Apply the first matching rule: (1) enemy_dy < 0 AND enemy_dx <= 64: dodge_left. (2) grounded is true AND lowest_floor_drop_px == 0: run_right. (3) retreating is true AND drop_px < 32 AND lowest_floor_drop_px > 0: brake_left. (4) blocked is true AND wall_height > headroom: brake_left. Otherwise run_right. Null means absent; a comparison to null does not match.

criteria.dodge_left: Step left to avoid a nearby enemy falling from above.

enemy.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

enemy_low.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 40 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

wall.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and (headroom_px is null OR height_px <= headroom_px). Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Do not jump at this wall.

pit.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and floor_gaps is not empty. Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Not time to jump; far away or a safe drop.
criteria.C: Jump over the nearby floor gap.

air.instructions: Which direction is Mario moving vertically?

instructions: This stage is UNDERWATER. Swim toward the exit on the right. If jump_held is true, choose right_run to release A. Otherwise, if feet_y is greater than80 choose right_run_jump to stroke upward. Otherwise choose right_run to swim right without ascending. Repeat strokes to stay near the top of the water.

criteria.right_run_jump: jump_held is false AND feet_y >80: swim upward and right.
criteria.right_run: jump_held is true OR feet_y <=80: release A and move right.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE: swim through the middle opening below the ceiling and above the floor. If jump_held is true release A by choosing right_run. Otherwise if feet_y >140 choose right_run_jump. Otherwise choose right_run.
OVERRIDE: swim through the opening. If jump_held is true choose right_run. Otherwise if feet_y >120 choose right_run_jump. Otherwise choose right_run.
OVERRIDE: swim high above the fish and tall coral. If jump_held is true choose right_run. Otherwise if feet_y >48 choose right_run_jump. Otherwise choose right_run.

OVERRIDE: First descend into the exit pipe; then jump up the overworld stairs. If note_elapsed_frames.exit-depth >100: choose right_run_jump when grounded or rising, otherwise right_run. If note_elapsed_frames.exit-depth <=100: choose right_run_jump only when jump_held is false AND feet_y >208, otherwise right_run.

criteria.right_run_jump: After100frames: grounded or rising. Before100frames: jump_held false and feet_y>208.
criteria.right_run: Otherwise release A and move right.
